pieces.text: The way an organism looks or acts is called a
. An organism can have many different traits.

contents.text: Some traits tell you how an organism looks. For example, a rose bush has green leaves. Other traits tell you how an organism acts. For example, a seal can swim.

pieces.text: Scientists
, or look at, organisms to learn about their traits. This helps scientists identify and compare organisms.

contents.text: Read the traits one at a time. Look at the lion. Decide which traits it has.

header.text: This lion has brown fur.
This lion does not have flippers.
This lion has four legs.
This lion does not have stripes.
